description: List the tables and column schemas on a DataCanvas staged by an openFDA search tool. Call before openfda_dataframe_query to discover the exact table name, column names, and DuckDB types needed for valid SQL. row_count is the full staged result set, not the inline preview count. Columns typed JSON hold nested openFDA objects/arrays — query them with DuckDB json functions.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from the canvas_id field of an openFDA search tool response (openfda_search_* or openfda_lookup_ndc), present when the search ran with stage=true.

name: openfda_dataframe_describe

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was described — pass to openfda_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is disabled — CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id does not correspond to an active canvas session. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

tables.description: All tables and views available on this canvas.

items.description: A registered table or view on the canvas.

columns.description: All columns in this table, in schema order.

items.description: A single column in the table.

name.description: Column name — use in SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY.

nullable.description: True when the column may contain NULL. Absent when unknown.

type.description: DuckDB type (VARCHAR, JSON, BIGINT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, ...).

kind.description: Object type: "table" for staged data, "view" for a derived view.

name.description: Table or view name — use verbatim in SQL FROM clauses.

row_count.description: Total rows in this table — the full staged set, not the inline preview.

title: Openfda Dataframe Describe
